description: Name crosswalk from geoBoundaries MYS ADM2 'shapeName' to the district spelling used by DOSM/OpenDOSM. Only spellings that are unambiguous are listed; any other name that fails to match a DOSM district during the OpenDOSM step is written to the import log for manual review. Do not guess: add a mapping only after checking the DOSM district list.
dosm_aliases_description: Spelling variants used in some OpenDOSM releases, mapped to the canonical DOSM district name, per state. Each was checked against the raw CSVs (same district, different release spelling). Districts created after the geoBoundaries ADM2 vintage (e.g. Sarawak's Gedong, Lingga, Pantu, Sebuyau, Siburan; Sabah's Membakut) have no polygon and stay unmatched in the import log on purpose.
moe_ppd_description: Ministry of Education enrolment, teacher and completion data are published by District Education Office (PPD), which do not always match administrative districts. Each office below was checked against the district list of the map: a name is the district the office lies in (counts of several offices in one district are added; their completion rates are left out, as rates cannot be added), null marks an office that spans two districts and cannot be split (no district figures for those districts). Perlis and the three federal territories take their state rows.
